page.overview:
Who is Icheb?

Icheb was a Brunali male, former Borg drone, and Delta Quadrant native who lived during the latter half of the 24th century.

Genetically-engineered, assimilated, and eventually repatriated by the crew of , Icheb became a valued member of their crew, joining them for the last two years of their journey back to Alpha Quadrant. ()

After spending nearly a decade with Starfleet, he fell victim to his own Borg past, when he was ultimately harvested for the very components that kept him alive. ()

Icheb was born on the Brunali homeworld to Yifay and Leucon. He was named after his father, whose middle name was Icheb. ()
